subject: Hospitality
title: The Head Chef's Authority
description: A 60-second lesson on The Head Chef's Authority.

hook.text: The head chef—or 'chef de cuisine'—has absolute authority in the kitchen. Their word is law during service.

buildup.text: They design menus, control food costs, hire and fire staff, and ensure every plate meets their exact standard.

discovery.text: The title 'chef' means 'chief' in French. A head chef is literally the chief commander of a culinary operation.

twist.text: Celebrity chefs rarely cook anymore. Gordon Ramsay manages 58 restaurants—he's a CEO who once cooked, not a daily cook.

climax.text: The tension between chef-as-artist and chef-as-business-manager defines modern high-end restaurants.

punchline.text: Chief of the kitchen, CEO of the brand. The role outgrew the stove.

quiz.question: What does the word 'chef' literally mean in French?
